svg.title: Six-Kernel Paranoid Proof Audit (Claim LA-19) and Three-Layer Compiled Intelligence Stack
svg.desc: Left panel shows the 82 LutAdapt Lean 4.36.0 theorems passing six independent proof checkers via lake check --paranoid (con-leche --verified, con-ron --verified, lean4lean, nanoda, leanchecker --paranoid, and Lean 4.36.0), neutralizing CVE-2026-72844, CVE-2026-72711, and native_decide exploits, paired with Inria Charon + Aeneas #![no_std] Rust MIR extraction. Right panel shows the three-layer compiled intelligence architecture spanning physical L0 control & LUT6 silicon, cognitive MoL downward compilation, and verifier-first Rust MCP runtime with tier-typed Joule receipts.
